subject.title: refactor(diffs): move ephemeral artifacts to SQLite

question: Should openBlobStore become a supported trusted-plugin SDK contract where every TTL-bearing BLOB is transient and excluded from backups, with active legacy Diffs URLs intentionally discarded during upgrade?
rationale: The code can implement either policy safely, but the permanent plugin API, trust privilege, backup meaning of TTL, and upgrade behavior require repository-owner intent rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Approve bounded contract
options.body: Accept the trusted-only API and transient TTL semantics after exact-head Diffs runtime and upgrade proof is attached.

options.title: Keep storage internal
options.body: Avoid expanding the public Plugin SDK and expose only a narrower internal Diffs-owned storage helper.

options.title: Preserve active legacy URLs
options.body: Add a bounded upgrade migration or compatibility window for unexpired sidecar artifacts before deleting the old runtime path.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded contract
recommendation.body: Accept the trusted-only API and transient TTL semantics after exact-head Diffs runtime and upgrade proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest observed connection to the plugin trust boundary, database-first direction, and the proposed implementation.
